about: When file search may answer a query from the rows it already holds, plugins/filesearch/query.lua sameShape and narrows. Two parses have the same shape when they ask about the same files, the same hidden and ignored, the same scope and the same extensions in the same order, whatever their text. One narrows the other when the shape is the same and the text only grew. narrows says nothing about the two conditions only the engine knows, that the held rows came from a search rather than the recent list and were not cut by the cap, so an empty query narrows to any text here and the engine refuses it.

cases.name: a second space is no growth, since whitespace collapses
a longer text under one type narrows
a type added is another shape
the same types in another order are another shape
asking for hidden paths is another shape
asking for ignored paths is another shape
a longer text in one scope narrows
an empty query narrows to any text, which the engine refuses
a browse narrows to a search in its scope
